article.story: LOUISVILLE, Ky. -- — Jack Karasinski scored 23 points as Bellarmine beat Florida Gulf Coast 81-65 on Saturday. Karasinski also added five rebounds for the Knights (11-13, 6-6 Atlantic Sun Conference). Tyler Doyle scored 19 points while shooting 7 of 15 from the floor. Sam Donald went 6 of 7 from the field (3 of 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 17 points. J.R. Konieczny finished with 20 points, nine rebounds and seven assists for the Eagles (10-15, 4-8). Jordan Ellerbee added 12 points and four assists for FGCU. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
